One attempt captures the complete normalized URL and selected theme. Pending shows Copying… / 正在复制…. Success, failure and finally may update only that same current attempt. Selection, filter URL changes, history, lens changes and page exit retire it, even after an A→B→A return. Each success timer belongs to its own attempt; an old completion cannot enable a newer action.
A current failure shows the captured URL in the existing manual fallback. Later focus, pointer intent or window blur relinquishes automatic focus; body focus alone grants nothing. Locale-only redraws preserve the current URL and translate owned feedback. A prior system clipboard write cannot be cancelled; no corrective write, queue, retry or persistence was added.

The enhanced tree has one sequential row entry, with arrows moving among visible rows. Hidden and empty categories cannot retain a Tab stop. Its existing bilingual heading supplies the accessible name. Native theme links keep their destinations and modified-click behavior; information buttons and See all stay separately reachable. Without JavaScript, the original 371 link attributes remain.

Plain Enter/Space on a leaf delegates to the existing topic-selection owner. Preserve parent expansion, modifiers, IME and repeat handling. Before search hides active row content, focus the search input; before collapse hides a descendant, focus its nearest visible ancestor. Preserve surviving and unrelated focus. Clearing a zero-result search restores expansion and uses the first visible row as the next entry.

Index shortcuts follow their filtered groups. Hidden, detached or unowned targets cannot replace the parameter fragment; reject stale observer entries before changing current-link state. Return focus before the index hides an active row, category or shortcut. Query, lens, open state and return context keep their existing owners.

The tree’s existing no-match paragraph now sits inside one persistent polite, atomic status region. Keep focus in search, preserve its bilingual text and skip unchanged visibility writes. Clear hides the paragraph while the status owner remains mounted. A scoped CSS rule offsets the extra empty flex gap: normal spacing stays 12 px; the visible message keeps its original margins. Before hiding an owned focus target, try reachable search, then Done inside an open native dialog or the visible opener/topic heading in the sidebar. Recheck actual focus: preserve a surviving redirect; continue the bounded fallback if focus remains in a retiring subtree. A newer synchronous filter pass cancels the stale projection. Keep surviving/unrelated focus and closed mobile Browse unchanged; skip unchanged hidden writes.

Generated data-gmi-total attributes restore the original totals on Clear. Keep the footer explicitly labelled Full index / 完整索引. The index now keeps one persistent polite/atomic wrapper around its existing visual feedback paragraph. Move the status role off the hidden paragraph; retain its count/no-match spans and language owner. indexHidden still releases owned focus before a hide request, then skips unchanged visibility writes. Show “This topic is outside your filters.” / “当前主题不在筛选范围内。” with Clear filters / 清除筛选 only when a valid selected topic is excluded. Invalid-topic and failed-data states keep their own explanations, without this unrelated action. Generated markup starts hidden when JavaScript is unavailable.

Join the existing data-topic-reset handler. Clear Browse query/category/scope/evidence, retain the selected theme, and use the current replace-URL path to preserve lens and return context and retire copy feedback. Do not select or rerender the answer: retain evidence-node identity, exact source fields and open receipts.

The answer-side caller returns focus to the visible topic heading; existing drawer/sidebar callers keep search focus. Before hiding a focused recovery action, focus that heading. Native modal behavior stays intact. Reuse current panel/button tokens, allow wrapping, expose the notice before changing its status text, and skip unchanged text writes. No extra timer, storage or announcement owner is needed.

Reset chooses that established heading/search destination before projecting filter visibility. Do not focus again after filters: a surviving intentional redirect must remain. Query/category/scope/evidence clear through the existing replace-URL owner; theme, lens, qualified return, evidence nodes and open receipts remain. History keeps its separate existing answer-render path.

The tree and full index share one localized Clear search / 清空搜索 icon button. It is hidden until JavaScript binds the existing input path. Keep the field 44 px high and the action 44 × 44 px. Replace the slash hint while the raw input is nonempty, including whitespace. Suppress the browser cancel only under the enhanced class.

Click and native Enter/Space focus the input, empty its value and dispatch the current input event once. Ordinary Escape uses that same helper; consumed, composing and keyCode229 events do nothing. The existing search, URL and expansion owners perform the reset. These tree/index actions do not clear primary Browse filters, select a different answer or redraw evidence.

Index initial/history restoration synchronizes the button from the restored value. Before hiding a focused clear action, return focus to search; preserve unrelated focus. Keep lens, qualified return, other hash keys and current disclosures. Use the existing locale owner. No second filter state, announcement cycle, timer or navigation owner is needed. For Escape already consumed, composing or carrying keyCode229, stop propagation and return without clearing the query, calling updateFilters or adding preventDefault. This also keeps that guarded event away from document bubble handlers while leaving the input method’s default behavior intact.

Ordinary Escape with a nonempty query keeps the existing preventDefault, stopPropagation, clear and updateFilters path. Retain the selected theme, category, scope, evidence filter, lens and answer nodes; keep focus in search. With an empty query, leave Escape to the browser so the existing native dialog cancel/close and opener-focus cleanup work. Do not add composition state, a cancel blocker, a timer or an ignore-next-close flag.

Synthetic composing/229 events prove this authored event contract, not OS-native IME behavior. Real consumed and ordinary Escape keys verify the query, history, focus and native dialog boundary separately. A one-use test cancel listener can keep the dialog open; removing that test-only prevention restores the next native dismissal.

Primary Browse now has its own 44 × 44 px Clear search / 清空搜索 button. It is visible for any nonempty raw input, including whitespace, and replaces the slash hint in the same slot. Bind the click before adding the enhancement class; leave it hidden without JavaScript or valid topic data. Use a plain wrapper with the input’s existing bilingual name, plus scoped primary padding/native-cancel rules.

Clear only the query through updateFilters once. Retain topic, category, scope, evidence-only, lens, qualified return, other hash fields, answer/source-card nodes and open receipts. The drawer stays open. Other filters may still yield zero matches; keep Clear all filters available. An already empty activation is inert.

The existing filters projection owns button visibility and pre-hide focus. Capture its pass and the URL before focusing search; if a focus callback projects newer state or begins hash restoration, yield. Respect surviving focus redirects and never focus a second time. Leave the accepted primary Escape handler unchanged. Q01/Q02 show EN390/ZH320; Q03/Q04 compare query Clear and full Reset on Browse · Search and filters, p-D-0.

Use the existing page_key=index branch in _gmi_product_header.html.j2. Keep GMI Explorer as a small real link with its .gmi-product-name hook and 44 px target; place the sole All micro-themes / 全部细分主题 H1 beside the one exact dated snapshot. Use a 32 px title on desktop and 24 px at ≤820, natural Chinese spacing, no fixed height and 16 px navigation/return gaps. The Index · Search and navigation page shows an EN390 default viewport and ZH320 filtered company-return/stale state. Two visible results and Full index: 371 stay distinct. At the existing ≤640 px breakpoint, show a native Category / 类别 select and a separate Go / 前往 button. Keep the select and Go 44 px high, Go 44 px wide, an 8 px gap and the existing 61 px sticky strip. Desktop and no-JS keep the original anchor track. Selection is a pending destination, not the category in view. Typeahead and selection never navigate. Go revalidates and invokes the retained category link, preserving query, lens, qualified return, other hash keys and history. Keep the selected ID for repeat jumps. Derive options from the existing visible groups and active-language labels/counts; available zero-count categories stay eligible. Use exactly page_key=companies in the shared header. Keep the small 44 px GMI Explorer link, one Company evidence / 公司证据 H1, the original snapshot/stale owner, active navigation, utility links and 72 px Brain reservation.
